title: Rift Runner fifty-level catalogue draft
scope: Regular saved progression; no grade UI. Physically successful wrong-English objective does not unlock. Help may be used without blocking completion.

rows.name: First Light
rows.geometryRoute: A short start chamber faces a glass partition and a visible exit alcove; an installed B portal is beyond glass. A second west exit is also reachable after traversal.
rows.newDemand: Learn movement, aiming and one portal placement before any cargo.

semanticDecision.required: Go through the rift and leave by the east door.

changedWordingCheck.mission: Go through the rift and leave by the west door.

rows.teaching: east הוא מזרח; west הוא יעד אחר, גם אם אפשר להגיע אליו.

normalizedGoalContract: Strict English goal gates unlock. Every directly requested crossing uses a real body/route event; portal:enter accepts either portal index. RISING means positive vertical movement, not descent. Generic cargo tasks accept equivalent real crates. Forbidden event history persists for the attempt. Order/during/throughout/history predicates refer to actual machine/body events; no arbitrary launch-used requirement. Assistance is allowed. All rows remain PLANNED until normal-input verification. Direct negative BEFORE instructions use temporal.forbiddenBefore [{event,after?,until}] over persistent attempt history; positive order matches a valid later subsequence.
